watch.en: STADA signed 110 business development and licensing deals in 2025.
watch.zh: STADA 在 2025 年签署了 110 项业务开发和许可交易。

watch.en: Its GLP-1 launch strategy explicitly targets loss-of-exclusivity opportunities in diabetes and obesity.
watch.zh: 其 GLP-1 上市策略明确瞄准糖尿病和肥胖领域的独占期结束 (LOE) 机会。

watch.en: Specialty exceeded €1 billion revenue in 2025, alongside Consumer Healthcare and Generics.
watch.zh: 2025 年,专科业务收入超过 €1 billion,此外还有消费者健康和仿制药业务。

watch.en: CTTQ leads TQB3570 development and supply; STADA holds exclusive commercial rights in specified European/Eurasian markets.
watch.zh: CTTQ 主导 TQB3570 的开发和供应;STADA 在指定的欧洲/欧亚市场拥有独家商业权利。

gaps: The latest financial release located was FY2025 results published March 18, 2026, older than June 2026; no H1 or Q3 2026 release was found through the investor/media pages and live search.

No consolidated asset-by-phase pipeline was found. All five included candidates have undisclosed phases in the sources read; phase is null throughout. These generic/commercial development programs are not classified as clinical Phase 1–3 by inference.

Candidate-specific lead indication for TQB3570 and ruxolitinib, and mechanisms/modalities not explicitly established for the generic versions, are null or identified as undisclosed in indication text.
Origins of the four generic candidates were not verified; origin is null. Candidate codes and future dated milestones were not disclosed; code and next are null where applicable.
Counts is null: launch/product totals are not company counts by clinical phase.
Already-approved biosimilars and specialty brands are excluded. TQB3570 evidence is the partner's own announcement; STADA's general biosimilars page supplies no candidate phase.

URL validation: the prescribed curl -sSIL check was attempted for every listed source URL; all returned HTTP 000 / curl error 6 (DNS resolution unavailable in the shell). These URLs were opened with the live web tool, but final HTTP HEAD status could not be independently verified.
